comment: Set 'id' to this device's directory name under devices/ (lowercase letters and digits only). Everything on the router is derived from it: firewall rule kidsout_<id>_out, helper /usr/libexec/kidsout-<id>, rpcd login kidsout-<id>. Fill 'interfaces' with './driver.sh discover --write' while the device is on; record EVERY interface (wired and wireless) or the block silently fails open whenever the device uses the missing one.

network._comment: The firewall zone the device sits in, and the zone it must not reach. Check with 'uci show firewall | grep name' on the router.

router._comment: primary_host is the router's LAN address; alt_hosts are tried after it (e.g. a VPN-side address). /ubus is uhttpd-mod-ubus's path; /cgi-bin/luci/rpc/ubus is a different API and does not work. tls_sha256 is written by './driver.sh pin'.

state._comment: 'up' means that since the previous sample EITHER the device's outbound byte rate exceeded threshold_out_bytes_per_min OR its inbound rate exceeded threshold_in_bytes_per_min (set it to null for outbound-only). The shipped values (200 KB/min out, 1 MB/min in) were calibrated on a game console and are a STARTING POINT ONLY: run './driver.sh calibrate' with the device idle, in active use and streaming, then set both in bytes (see DESIGN.md §5). A sample older than max_sample_age_s is discarded as stale rather than averaged over the gap. Every rule_audit_period_s the driver logs what the router is actually enforcing.

discover._comment: Substrings of the device's DHCP hostname, used by 'discover' to find its MAC(s). Defaults to the id when omitted. Case-insensitive.
